# Ownly Network — China Hot-List Deletion Watch

> Ownly Network monitors China's hot-search lists (Weibo 微博, Baidu 百度, Zhihu 知乎, Toutiao 今日头条, Bilibili 哔哩哔哩, Douyin 抖音, Kuaishou 快手) and flags topics that leave a list abruptly while still popular. A topic is labeled "Dropped off" by default and "Likely censored" only when there is hard evidence (a dead link, a platform removal notice, or a matching entry on a censorship tracker). Data coverage: 2026-10-18 to 2026-11-09.

## Live data
- [Dropped off today](https://ownly-network.github.io/china-news-feed-samples/): topics that left a hot list in the last 24 hours.
- [Today's dropped-off topics as JSON](https://ownly-network.github.io/china-news-feed-samples/deleted-today.json): the live page as JSON. Item fields: platform, title_zh, title_en, label, label_zh, peak_rank, first_seen_et, last_seen_et, first_missing_et, minutes_on_list, url, evidence, official_line.
- [Atom feed](https://ownly-network.github.io/china-news-feed-samples/feed.xml): one entry per dropped-off topic, newest first.

## Archive
- [Archive index](https://ownly-network.github.io/china-news-feed-samples/archive/index.html): every past day, newest first.

## Full product
- [Apify actor — full live feed, $8 per 1,000 rows](https://apify.com/china.unofficial/china-news-feed)
- [Hugging Face dataset — free sample](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ownly-network/china-news-feed-sample)
- [Hugging Face Space — What vanished this week](https://huggingface.co/spaces/ownly-network/china-deletion-watch)
- [GitHub repo](https://github.com/Ownly-Network/china-news-feed-samples)

## Publisher
China News Feed.
